mapper.sql: SELECT id, student_class, teacher, course, course_type, content, start_date, end_date, update_date FROM class_log
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_log (id, student_class, teacher, course, course_type, content, start_date, end_date, update_date) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentClass}, #{teacher}, #{course}, #{courseType}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{updateDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_log SET student_class = #{studentClass}, teacher = #{teacher}, course = #{course}, course_type = #{courseType}, content = #{content}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WHERE studentClass = #{studentClass} AND DATE(startDate) >= CURDATE() AND courseType IN ('功課', '測驗') ORDER BY startDate
WHERE studentClass = #{studentClass} AND startDate BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND courseType IN ('功課', '測驗') ORDER BY startDate DESC
WHERE studentClass = #{studentClass} AND DATE(startDate) = CURDATE() AND courseType IN ('功課', '測驗') ORDER BY startDate
WHERE studentClass = #{studentClass} AND DATE(startDate) BETWEEN DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND courseType IN ('功課', '測驗') ORDER BY startDate
